sloka: प्रविष्टायां तु सीतायां भूतलं सत्यसम्पदा ।तस्यावसाने यज्ञस्य रामः परमदुर्मनाः ।। ७.९९.३ ॥
transliteration: praviṣṭāyāṁ tu sītāyāṁ bhūtalaṁ satyasampadā ।tasyāvasāne yajñasya rāmaḥ paramadurmanāḥ ।। 7.99.3 ॥

translations.english: And when Sita entered the earth by the power of her truth, at the conclusion of that sacrifice, Rama became extremely distressed.
